name: SKOTOS
source:
Your everyday life is interrupted by divine intervention. What is its purpose? What will you do with it?

[From [url=https://abra-geroni.itch.io/skotos]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的平凡日常被突如其来的神明干预打破。神明此举究竟意欲何为？面对这份天降异变，你又将如何抉择？

[摘自[url=https://abra-geroni.itch.io/skotos]itch.io[/url]]
